description: Open interest for BTC across exchanges (perpetual futures). Returns per-exchange open interest in USD plus 24h change for a coin symbol. Example: coinglass_open_interest({ symbol: "BTC", _apiKey: "your-key" })

exchange.description: Optional — filter to a single exchange, e.g. "Binance", "OKX", "Bybit"

name: coinglass_open_interest
title: Coinglass Open Interest
